hook_text: You can find your way across a city without a single street sign. You just need landmarks.
clip_script: Ayanda lives in Durban. On her way to school she passes a giant old fig tree, crosses the bridge over the Umgeni River, turns at the tall water tower and keeps the great arch of the stadium on her right. Tree and river: natural landmarks. Bridge, tower and stadium: human-made landmarks. Put them in order, draw them on a page with arrows from home to school, and you have drawn a journey.
visual_style: Whiteboard route drawn as a dotted line from a little house to a school, with a fig tree, a river, a bridge, a water tower and a stadium arch appearing along it.
mood: Like a treasure map coming to life.
pacing: Walk the route once with the landmarks, sort them into natural and human-made, then draw it.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw your own way to school with three landmarks.
